info.name: ESR — IWCRCM Integration
info.description:
IWCRCM (Industrial Water Consumption and Revenue Monitoring) requests.

Folder 1 calls the IWCRCM provider directly (per the official PDF). Folder 2 calls this ESR server's admin endpoints.

NO real secrets are stored here. Fill the collection variables locally and never commit them.

Note: the Iot_Key (response code) needs the scramble algorithm, and the /main body must be RSA-encrypted with node-rsa. Neither can be produced inside Postman — the ESR server does both. Use folder 2 → 'Run IWCRCM tick now' for real end-to-end tests. See IWCRCM_INTEGRATION.md.

request.description:
PDF step 1–2. `new` may be any value per the PDF (table: Boolean, max length 4).

Expected 200:
```json
{ "id": "TNXWFM003", "key": "<challenge code>", "expire": "<date/time, ~2 minutes>" }
```
(The PDF shows this object as `newkey { ... }`; the ESR client accepts either form.)

Errors: HTTP status codes are not documented in the PDF.

item.name: Auth step 2 — submit response code, receive 24h auth key

request.description:
PDF step 3–5. Must be sent within ~2 minutes of step 1.

`Iot_Key` = response code derived from the challenge with the provider's scramble algorithm (NOT in the PDF — REQUIRED FROM IWCRCM API PROVIDER).

Expected 200:
```json
{ "id": "TNXWFM003", "key": "<auth key>", "expire": "<date/time, 24 hours>" }
```
Errors: wrong response code or expired challenge → rejected (status code not documented).

PDF step 7–10. Body = base64 node-rsa encryption (IWCRCM public key) of:
```json
{
  "payload": { "id": "TNXWFM003", "loc": "85.8245,20.2961", "ts": 1790666400000, "flow": 120.5, "qty": 4500.25, "roll": 0, "key": "<auth key>" },
  "hash": "<sha256 hex of JSON.stringify(payload)>"
}
```
Expected 200: `{ "Action": "OK" }`

Errors: 403 when decryption, hash, or key validation fails (per PDF).

item.name: Map a tank to an IWCRCM device

request.description:
Admin only. `deviceId` = department-issued IWCRCM id (1–11 chars A-Z0-9), unique per tank.

200 → updated tank. 400 → validation (id/coordinates required when enabled). 409 → IWCRCM id already used by another tank.

Admin only (control_room → 403).

200:
```json
{ "data": { "enabled": true, "configReady": false, "configIssues": ["..."], "sendIntervalMinutes": 60, "nextScheduledAt": "...",
  "devices": [{ "tankName": "...", "iwcrcmDeviceId": "TNXWFM003", "lastStatus": "PENDING", "lastSuccessAt": null, "lastAttemptAt": null, "authExpiresAt": null, "pending": 1, "failed": 0, "nextScheduledAt": "..." }] } }
```

Admin only. Queues the last completed slot (if not already queued) and sends due records.

200 → `{ enqueued: {queued, skippedNoData, invalid} | null, processed: {processed, success, retrying, failed} | null }` (`processed` is null while config is incomplete).
409 → IWCRCM_ENABLED=false.
Admin only. Moves FAILED records back to PENDING (attempts reset). Omit `tankId` to re-queue all. 400 → invalid tankId.
